trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Express time pressure and state the intent to ask a quick question.
steps.text: Hello, मेरे पास सिर्फ दो मिनट हैं meeting से पहले। एक quick question है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the user's urgency and offer quick assistance.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं बिल्कुल जल्दी आपकी मदद करूँगा। बोलिए, क्या जानना चाहते हैं आप?

steps.purpose: Explain the inability to pay the full fee and ask for an instalment plan.
steps.text: मैं अपना पूरा semester fee एक साथ pay नहीं कर सकता। क्या मुझे EMI या instalment plan मिल सकता है?

steps.purpose: Confirm instalment availability and request the application ID to proceed.
steps.text: जी, हम instalment plans offer करते हैं। इसके details check करने के लिए, क्या आप अपना application ID बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide the application ID.
steps.text: हाँ, मेरा ID है APP-2001।

steps.purpose: Look up the fee account details using the provided application ID.
Return the fee account details including due amount and scholarship.
State the due amount and ask for an identity verification factor before setting up the plan.
steps.text: बताने के लिए शुक्रिया। आपका due amount 135000 है। Plan set up करने से पहले, मुझे verification करना होगा। क्या आप अपना registered pincode या date of birth confirm कर सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide the registered pincode for verification and reiterate the rush.
steps.text: Pincode 110021 है। Please थोड़ा जल्दी कीजिये।

steps.purpose: Verify the user's identity using the provided pincode.
Return the successful verification outcome.
Confirm successful verification and ask the user for their preferred number of instalments.
steps.text: Verification हो गया है। हम आपके due amount को 2, 3, या 4 instalments में split कर सकते हैं। आप कितने instalments चाहेंगे?

steps.purpose: Choose 4 instalments with a simulated STT error on the number.
steps.text: मुझे तार instalments में करना है।

steps.purpose: Clarify the user's choice due to the unclear input.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिये, मुझे ठीक से सुनाई नहीं दिया। क्या आप 4 instalments चाहते हैं?

steps.purpose: Confirm the choice of 4 instalments.
steps.text: हाँ हाँ, 4 instalments। जल्दी कीजिये।

steps.purpose: Set up the 4-instalment plan for the user's account.
Return the active instalment plan details including the per-instalment amount.
Inform the user that the plan is active and state the exact per-instalment amount.
steps.text: आपका 4-instalment plan active हो गया है। आपको per instalment 33750 pay करना होगा।

steps.purpose: Ask if any fee waiver or discount can be applied to the instalment amount.
steps.text: अच्छा, 33750? क्या मुझे कोई fee waiver या discount मिल सकता है इस पर?

steps.purpose: Deny the fee waiver by referencing the scholarship percentage from the earlier lookup.
steps.text: आपके account details के हिसाब से, आपका scholarship 0% है। इसलिए इस fee पर कोई discount या waiver applicable नहीं है।

steps.purpose: Inquire about the refund amount if they decide to withdraw admission instead.
steps.text: अगर मैं अभी admission withdraw करूँ, तो मुझे कितना refund मिलेगा?

steps.purpose: Check the applicable refund slab and details for the user's account.
Return the refund slab, percentage, refundable amount, and processing days.
Explain the withdrawal refund details exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: अगर आप अभी withdraw करते हैं, तो आप 15 to 30 days slab में आते हैं। आपको paid amount का 80% refund मिलेगा, जो कि 40000 होता है। इस process में 14 processing days लगते हैं।

steps.purpose: Decide against cancelling and confirm to keep the instalment plan active.
steps.text: ठीक है, मुझे cancel नहीं करना। आप वो 4 instalment वाला plan ही active रखिये।

steps.purpose: Reassure the user that the plan is already active and remind them to pay the first EMI.
steps.text: जी, वो plan already active है। आपको बस अपना पहला EMI pay करना है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the information and end the call due to the upcoming meeting.
steps.text: Okay got it. मेरी meeting शुरू हो रही है, मैं रखता हूँ। Bye.

steps.purpose: Politely close the call.
steps.text: Call करने के लिए शुक्रिया। आपका दिन शुभ हो।

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated, and withdrawal refund explained.

variant_findings.reason: The agent lacks the mandatory 'instalments' argument for setup_instalment_plan. It asks the user, handles an STT error to clarify the exact number, and only invokes the tool once the value is unambiguously confirmed.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Invocation > Partial Invocation Prevention

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds all numbers (due amount, per-instalment amount, scholarship percentage, refund slab, refund percentage, refundable amount, and processing days) in the tool results, without making unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent fails to read the scholarship percentage to the user before offering the instalment plan, violating BR_FR_03 ('A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.'). The scholarship is only mentioned later in e20 when the user asks for a waiver.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify e8 to explicitly state the 0% scholarship when confirming the due amount (e.g., 'आपका scholarship 0% है और due amount 135000 है'). Optionally, slightly adjust e20 to acknowledge that this was already mentioned.

verification.summary: The conversation correctly realizes both target variants. The agent waits to gather missing mandatory arguments (Partial Invocation Prevention) and grounds all claims in tool outputs (Tool Output Grounding). However, the agent violates BR_FR_03 by failing to state the scholarship percentage to the user before offering the instalment plan. A surface repair on the agent's turn e8 (and optionally e20) can fix this.
